# @ndigo/jobs

Durable job queues, worker execution, and the transactional outbox for Node.js

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Capabilities

- `background-jobs` — Deliver background work: a sample worker plus the queue and runner — swap drivers from in-process to durable without touching handlers. Packages: `@ndigo/jobs`. Guide: `jobs-and-outbox`.

## Public exports

- `ClaimOptions` *(type)* — Claim window for `JobDriver.claim`.
- `JobId` *(type)* — Identifier of a queued job (a UUID string).
- `JobRecord` *(type)* — A stored job as returned by a driver — the record handed to `JobDriver.claim` callers and into handler execution.
- `JobRequest` *(type)* — A producer-supplied request to enqueue one job.
- `ResolvedJobRequest` *(type)* — A normalized request as stored by a driver: `runAt` and `maxAttempts` are resolved, and `delayMs` is gone.
- `likeJobDriver` — Structural check for a JobDriver value.
- `JobDriver` *(type)* — Storage/transport contract for queued jobs.
- `DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS` — Attempts a job allows when the request does not say otherwise.
- `parseJobPayload` — Parses stored payload text back to its value.
- `resolveJobRequest` — Validates a producer request and resolves its defaults against `now` (`runAt ?? now + delayMs ?? now`, `maxAttempts ?? DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS`).
- `serializeJobPayload` — Serializes a job payload to the stored JSON text.
- `InProcessJobDriver` — Map-backed JobDriver with the full contract semantics — `runAt` ordering, attempts-at-claim, lease expiry reclaimed inside `claim`, and terminal `complete`/`fa…
- `InProcessJobDriverOptions` *(type)* — Options for InProcessJobDriver.
- `JobQueue` — The producer-facing queue: `enqueue` one job, inspect `size` — nothing else (claiming and completion belong to "job-runner".JobRunner).
- `JobQueueOptions` *(type)* — Options for JobQueue.
- `JOB_HANDLER_METADATA_PREFIX` — Metadata key prefix under which `@jobHandler` writes its per-method registration (`jobs:handler:<methodName>`).
- `getJobHandlerMetadata` — Reads the registration recorded by `@jobHandler` for a method.
- `jobHandler` — Marks a method as the handler for one job type.
- `JobHandler` *(type)* — A job handler: receives the payload and execution context, resolves when the work is done. Failures (throw / rejection) drive the retry policy.
- `JobHandlerContext` *(type)* — Execution context handed to a handler alongside the payload.
- `JobHandlerMetadata` *(type)* — The registration `@jobHandler` records for a method.
- `JobHandlerOptions` *(type)* — Per-handler policy overrides. Either value, when set, wins over the per-request value stored on the job record.
- `JobHandlerRegistry` — Holds the job-type → handler mapping. Two registration paths:
- `likeJobHandlerRegistry` — Structural type guard for JobHandlerRegistry — the `like*` convention used where an entry or option is verified before use (sibling of "job-driver".likeJobDriv…
- `RegisteredJobHandler` *(type)* — One registered handler, ready to execute.
- `JobRunner` — The worker engine: single-flight poll ticks, `concurrency` execution slots, per-execution timeout (cooperative `AbortSignal`), lease heartbeat, exponential-bac…
- `JobRunnerOptions` *(type)* — Options for JobRunner.
- `startJobSpan` — Opens an INTERNAL span for one job execution (`jobs.job.<type>`, attributes `job.id`, `job.type`, `job.attempt`).
- `JobSpan` *(type)* — One in-flight job-execution span, ended exactly once by the runner.
- `JobOutboxPublisher` — The canonical publisher: outbox entries become jobs on a JobQueue (`type` → job type, `payload` → job payload) — the transactional side effect of `outbox.appen…
- `likeOutboxStore` — Structural check for an OutboxStore value.
- `OutboxClaimOptions` *(type)* — Claim window for OutboxStore.claimPending.
- `OutboxEntry` *(type)* — One recorded side effect awaiting publication.
- `OutboxPublisher` *(type)* — Publishes one outbox entry. Implementations must be idempotent-friendly: a failed publish is retried after the claim lease expires.
- `OutboxStore` *(type)* — Durable store for outbox entries.
- `InProcessOutboxStore` — Map-backed OutboxStore with the full claim/lease semantics but **no transaction to join**: `append` succeeds unconditionally, so it is a test double and develo…
- `InProcessOutboxStoreOptions` *(type)* — Options for InProcessOutboxStore.
- `OutboxRelay` — The relay half of the transactional outbox: polls OutboxStore.claimPending, publishes through an OutboxPublisher, then `markPublished`. A failed publish leaves…
- `OutboxRelayOptions` *(type)* — Options for OutboxRelay.
- `JOB_DRIVER` — Token for the active JobDriver entry. `NodeAutoConfiguration` registers the in-process default; apps register a durable driver to replace it.
- `JOB_HANDLER_REGISTRY` — Token for the JobHandlerRegistry entry that scans `@jobHandler` methods and holds the registered handlers.
- `JOB_QUEUE` — Token for the producer-facing JobQueue entry.
- `JOB_RUNNER` — Token for the JobRunner entry that polls the driver and executes handlers.
